text:
Rina: quick design pass on the trace viewer export + stacktrace controls — a few clarity + a11y fixes I think we should ship in the next patch.
Devon: thanks, can you bullet the issues so we can triage?
Rina: sure:
• Export label currently says "Download" — ambiguous if it's json vs zip. Suggest "Export trace (.zip)" since we bundle snapshots.
• Correlation id copy: the copy icon is first in DOM on mobile so SR reads "button" then id. Flip DOM order or add aria-label "Copy correlation id 5f3a".
• Stack frame control reads "more" when collapsed — ambiguous. Prefer "Show full stack" / "Hide full stack" and aria-expanded toggle.
Priya: agree on the copy. Also suggest filename pattern: trace-<corrid>-YYYYMMDD.zip so engineers can find exports later.
Devon: backend currently sets filename=trace.json — i'll update Content-Disposition and add X-Trace-Filename header when zip produced.
Jordan: keyboard nav: when export moves into overflow on narrow widths, users can't arrow through menu items. We'll add roving tabindex + left/right arrows for menu and keep Export visible longer in action order.
Rina: small UX tweaks:
• On narrow screens show icon-only export but keep aria-label and sr-only text.
• Tooltip shows shortcut hint: "Export (Shift+E)".
Priya: analytics: emit trace.export with props {location: "toolbar", format: "zip", corr_id: "5f3a"} so dashboards can split by UI surface.
Devon: i'll split into two PRs: frontend markup + keyboard tests, backend header update. will request a11y review and add axe in CI.
build-bot: Reminder: include changelog entry. :robot_face:
Rina: opening a short PR for copy + aria now, will link backend follow-up. If no objections i'll merge after a11y sign-off. :thumbsup:
